Alex: CI is failing on the helm chart schema validation for gpu-pool. PR is blocked by the lint job :grimacing:
Alex: Error: schema validation: 'items' is not allowed here? I pasted the failing snippet below. anyone seen this pattern?
Alex: ```json
{"values.schema.json": {"properties": {"gpuPools": {"type": "array","items": {"type": "object","properties": {"name": {"type": "string"},"size": {"type": "integer"}}}}}}
```
Jamie: hm Helm's values schema validation (kubeval-like) can be picky when we rely on strategicMergePatch overlays in templates. CI might be using `helm schema-test` that uses Kubernetes JSON schema rules.
Sasha: is the real failure when the downstream overlay tries to merge in a map into that array? we had a similar issue with the nodeSelector list last quarter.
Priya: CI output shows: `Error: values.schema.json: gpuPools.items: Additional properties are not allowed` — which usually means the actual values in the PR include keys not listed in schema.items.properties.
Alex: But the values in the PR are `[{"name":"a","size":4,"gpuType":"v100"}]` — we intentionally omitted gpuType from schema to be permissive.
Jamie: Right — schema is strict by default. We either add gpuType to the schema or make items.allowAdditionalProperties = true.
Sasha: In JSON Schema draft-07 syntax that's `additionalProperties: true` on the items object. Helm's values.schema.json supports that.
Priya: Quick hack: add `"additionalProperties": true` under gpuPools.items in the schema. That unblocks the PR but is it safe?
Jamie: It is safe for now, but if we want to lock fields for validation we should enumerate required fields and keep additionalProperties false. For extensible fields (like vendor-specific tags) allowAdditionalProperties is fine.
Alex: Would the lint job still catch typos if we allow additionalProperties? worried about silent bad keys like `sizee`.
Sasha: we can add `patternProperties` to catch common misspellings, but that's ... overkill. Another option: make the schema require `name` and `size` and add `additionalProperties: true` so required is enforced but extra fields tolerated.
Priya: Also note: helm template + kustomize overlays can transform shapes: if an overlay adds a top-level map with a replace strategy we sometimes get array->map mismatches. Are we sure the overlay here doesn't change shape?
Alex: Good point. The overlay for dedicated accounts uses `helm.sh/hook`: we patch gpuPools by index sometimes. The patch in the PR does `{{- $pools := .Values.extraGpuPools }}` and then `{{- range $p := $pools }}` to append. Should be fine.
ci-bot: Pipeline failed: .ci/helm-schema-check.sh exit 2 — https://ci.internal/reports/1876543210
infra-bot: Deploy job paused because chart-lint job failed on branch feature/add-gpu-type :no_entry_sign:
Jamie: Proposed patch: in values.schema.json set: `gpuPools: {"type":"array","items": {"type":"object","additionalProperties": true, "properties": {"name": {"type":"string"}, "size": {"type":"integer"}}}, "required": ["name","size"]}`
Sasha: test locally with `helm lint --values test/values-with-gputype.yaml` and `yq` check: `cat test/values-with-gputype.yaml | ./ci/helm-schema-check.sh`
Priya: I'll push the small schema tweak and a unit test values file that includes gpuType and an intentional typo `sizee` to show it fails when required missing.
Alex: thanks Priya. pls also add a short note in PR description explaining why additionalProperties is true (extensibility for vendor tags) so reviewers don't rollback.
Priya: will do. pushing fix now, re-running CI.
ci-bot: Rerun queued.
infra-bot: FYI added temporary exception in pipeline to allow a one-time override for this branch while we iterate.
Jamie: long-term we should document merging expectations for charts that expose array-of-objects — maybe a section in chart-contrib docs about when to prefer maps vs arrays for patch-friendly overlays.
Sasha: +1. Arrays are painful with strategicMerge patches. maps (keyed by name) are easier.
Alex: ok let's close this blocker once CI passes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
